Bill.BriefDescription: Supporting the continued operation of the northwest weather and avalanche center.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to promoting safe winter recreation by supportingthe continued operation of the northwest weather and avalanche center;adding a new section to chapter 46.10 RCW; adding new sections tochapter 79A.05 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the northwestweather and avalanche center provides valuable avalanche forecastingand education services, provides valuable information to the public,and reduces the impacts of adverse mountain weather and avalanches onrecreation, industry, and transportation in Washington state. The northwest weather and avalanche center is cooperatively fundedby a number of public and private entities. In recent years, however,several budget crises have threatened to shut down the avalanchecenter, posing risks to recreation safety, tourism, and freight andpassenger mobility. Therefore, it is the intent of the legislature to ensure, incontinued cooperation with the federal government, appropriate states,and private sources, that the northwest weather and avalanche centerreceive the resources necessary to continue providing weather and p. 1 SB 5596avalanche forecasts for the benefit of Washington state. It is alsothe intent of the legislature that any resources provided to the centerthrough this act be in addition to, and not supplant, current supportfrom the state.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In addition to the registration fees collected under RCW46.10.040, the department shall collect a northwest weather andavalanche center surcharge of two dollars. The revenue generated fromthe surcharge must be deposited in the northwest weather and avalanchecenter account established in section 4 of this act to be used solelyto support the operation of the northwest weather and avalanche center. (2) This section applies to registrations due or to become due onor after October 1, 2009.

(1) In addition to the fees collected forwinter recreation area parking permits authorized under RCW 79A.05.230,the commission shall collect a northwest weather and avalanche centersurcharge of two dollars. The revenue generated from the surchargemust be deposited in the northwest weather and avalanche center accountestablished in section 4 of this act to be used solely to support theoperation of the northwest weather and avalanche center. (2) This section applies to winter recreation area parking permitspurchased on or after October 1, 2009.

The northwest weather and avalanche centeraccount is created in the state treasury. All receipts from thenorthwest weather and avalanche center surcharges collected undersections 2 and 3 of this act must be deposited into the account.Moneys in the account may be spent only after appropriation.Expenditures from the account may be used only to support the operationof the northwest weather and avalanche center.

The commission shall collaborate withappropriate public and private entities to seek sustainable andcooperative funding for the northwest weather and avalanche center, SB 5596 p. 2 with equitable contributions from the federal government, appropriatestates, and private sources.
Sections 3 through 5 of this act are eachadded to chapter 79A.05 RCW.
